title: EvidenceAssertion
description: Entity-shape schema for a persisted scientific object. It is NOT a request DTO: do not bind a client-supplied body directly to it. The fields id, version, schema_ref, lifecycle_state, created_by, created_at and visibility_policy_id are server-authoritative (docs/23 §3, docs/12 §3).

created_by.description: Server-authoritative: the server derives this from the authenticated actor and the evaluated policy context. It MUST NOT be accepted from client input. Authorization is default-deny and evaluated per command against actor+org+project+object+action+policy context (docs/23 §3); visibility expansion requires explicit authorized human action with an audit event (docs/12 §3, docs/23 §4).
